UserGuidance.title: User Guidance
UserGuidance.description: Master GlossaryAI with our step-by-step guides for translation, history tracking, and glossary management.
UserGuidance.demoVideoDescription: In this video, we will walk you through the core features of GlossaryAI, from uploading your first document to managing your glossaries.
UserGuidance.demoVideoNoteText: Please turn on Subtitles/CC in the video player to see the detailed guidance for each step!
UserGuidance.step1Description: Upload your documents and select the source and target languages for translation. You can also choose to translate images in your document or not.
UserGuidance.step2Description: Select any relevant glossaries to ensure accurate terminology translation.
UserGuidance.step3Description: Check your configuration to make sure everything is set up correctly before proceeding.
UserGuidance.step4Description: Begin the translation process and download the files once completed.
UserGuidance.historySubtitle: Track and manage your past jobs
UserGuidance.viewPastJobsDescription: Access a complete list of your previous translations. Each entry includes details like the date, file type, source and target languages, and the final status of the translation.
UserGuidance.smartSearchDescription: Quickly find specific translations by searching for file names or unique job IDs. This is helpful when you need to locate a specific document from weeks ago.
UserGuidance.redownloadDescription: Need a file again? You can easily download your original uploaded documents or the resulting translated files at any time from your history records.
UserGuidance.createImportDescription: Start by creating a new glossary to define your preferred terminology. You can build it term-by-term or import an existing text file (.txt) to populate it instantly.
UserGuidance.editManageDescription: Keep your glossaries up to date. You can edit definitions, add new terms as your project evolves, or delete glossaries that are no longer needed.

DashboardTour.welcomeDescription: Your centralized workspace for managing all translation resources. Take about 30 seconds to explore the key metrics.
DashboardTour.historyDescription:
This number shows the total documents you have translated.



Click here to open the History page, where you can download original files and review previous translations.
DashboardTour.glossaryDescription:
This number shows the total terms currently in use.



Click here to open the Glossary page, where you can create new entries, import from CSV/TXT, or edit your terminology list.
DashboardTour.documentsDescription:
This number shows the total original documents you have uploaded.



Click here to open the Documents page, where you can view and manage your uploaded files.
DashboardTour.uploadDescription:
Drag and drop files here to start the translation process.



Tip: You can configure your Glossary and image translation options in the next step after uploading.

Onboarding.welcomeDescription: Let's take a quick tour to help you get started and explore the main features of GlossaryAI.
Onboarding.translateWelcomeDescription: Follow upcoming steps to translate your file.
Onboarding.dashboardCardsDescription: View your total translations, active glossaries, and uploaded documents. Click on any card to access detailed information.
Onboarding.statsTranslationsDescription: Track all your completed and ongoing translation jobs. Click to view your full translation history.
Onboarding.statsGlossariesDescription: Manage your terminology databases to ensure consistent and accurate translations across all your documents.
Onboarding.statsDocumentsDescription: View all documents you've uploaded to the platform. Click to see the complete list.
Onboarding.quickUploadDescription: Go ahead and upload a document right now! Drag and drop a file or click here to start your translation journey.
Onboarding.step1Description: Start by uploading a document you want to translate. We support PDF, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel files.
Onboarding.step2Description: Choose your source language and the language you want to translate to. You can easily swap them using the middle button.
Onboarding.step3Description: Toggle this option if you want to translate images within your document as well.
Onboarding.step4Description: Choose from your existing glossaries to ensure accurate translation of specific terms.
Onboarding.stepCreateGlossaryDescription: Need a new glossary? Click here to create one instantly without leaving this page.
Onboarding.step4_SettingsDesc: Give your glossary a name and choose the language pair.
Onboarding.step4_ManualDesc: You can manually type each term here. Enter the Source term on the left and the Target term on the right.
Onboarding.step4_ImportDesc: Or import a .txt file. Format each line as: Source, Target for quick bulk addition.
Onboarding.step5Description: Before starting the translation, review all your settings to make sure everything is correct.
Onboarding.step6Description: Once you're ready, click this button to begin the translation process. You can track the progress in real-time.
Onboarding.fileTooLarge: File is too large. Maximum size is {maxSize}MB.

GlossaryListTour.welcomeDescription:
This is where you "teach" AI how to translate your company's specialized terms correctly.

Using Glossaries makes translations more consistent and accurate.
GlossaryListTour.createDescription: You can create an empty glossary and enter terms manually, or Import quickly from an existing Excel/CSV file.
GlossaryListTour.tabsDescription: Switch between My Glossaries, explore the Marketplace, or view glossaries Shared with you.
GlossaryListTour.searchDescription: When you have many dictionaries, use this tool to quickly find them by name or description.
GlossaryListTour.detailDescription:
Each card shows source/target languages and term count.

Click on the card to view terms, or use the (...) menu to Edit/Delete, or click the Share button to share this glossary with others.

GlossaryCreateTour.welcomeDescription: Let's learn how to create a specialized dictionary to help AI translate more correctly and consistently.
GlossaryCreateTour.nameDescription: Clear naming helps manage multiple dictionaries. Example: "Medical Terms", "Tech Products"
GlossaryCreateTour.langDescription: Define the language pair. Once saved, you cannot change these 2 fields.
GlossaryCreateTour.descDescription: Add notes about the purpose of this glossary to help the team understand.
GlossaryCreateTour.tabsDescription:
Manual Entry: Type each term.

Import File: Upload CSV/TXT for bulk import.
GlossaryCreateTour.tableDescription:
Enter Source (original term) and Target (desired translation).

The system auto-suggests Target = Source if left empty.
GlossaryCreateTour.addTermDescription: Click this button to add a new term entry row. You can add as many terms as you like.
GlossaryCreateTour.saveDescription: Review the summary information. When everything looks good, click Save to finish.
